lines.name: 190 Series Trim 19/32" x 3" x 16'
lines.note: Batten strips — wall area ÷ (12"/12) + 1 run × wall height when taped, 12" on-center (trade spec, default 12"), 16' stock, no waste

lines.note: Fascia 184.17 LF + rake 136.58 LF ÷ 16, whole-stick count is the entire allowance; 8" width is contractor-spec

lines.name: 540 Series Trim 5/4" x 4" x 16'
lines.note: Measured opening perimeter 574.33 LF − door bottoms (garage 1×16' + entry 3×3' + SGD 3×8') ÷ 16 — doors trim 3 sides + frieze 215.67+129.83 LF per-segment = 23 + ISC 6 corner(s) per-corner round-up = 6

lines.name: 540 Series OSC 5/4" x 6" x 16'
lines.note: OSC 14 corner(s) × per-corner whole-stick round-up (140.33 LF total, min 1 pc/corner) — 1 taped TALL corner(s) [18.42'] take ceil(h/16) sticks each — taped height counts, never the average — HUMAN count 14 (report read 20, shown for comparison)

lines.name: Touch up kits

lines.name: OSI Quad Max Caulking

lines.name: J blocks

lines.name: Mini Splits
